name: Crumple
description: The first clip crumples into a creased paper ball, shaded along its folds, which is then tossed away to reveal the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: creases
params.description: Number of folds creasing the paper

params.name: size
params.description: Radius of the paper ball, relative to the frame height

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the ball is tossed toward (x right, y up)

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the bare paper showing through the ink along the sharpest creases

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip (alpha: strength)
